candidates.exact_span: Effluent value reported as "< detection level" (DL) but the DL is greater than MQL, input "1/2 DL" for calculation.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a reported value is treated as half the detection limit versus another substitute directly changes the numeric concentration used for limit comparison (A) and whether a non-detect is treated as usable data or as a missing/non-input state (C).

candidates.exact_span: Effluent value reported as "< detection level" (DL) and the DL is smaller than MQL, no data is inputted.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The rule that no data is input when DL < MQL determines whether a measurement can be compared to a numeric limit at all (A) and whether the period is classified as documented no-data versus having an imputed numeric value (C).

candidates.exact_span: If a less than MQL vakue is reported, input either the reported value or "0" for calculation.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The permissive either/or choice between the reported sub-MQL value and zero can yield different calculated concentrations and compliance outcomes (A) and different classifications of how missing or below-MQL evidence should be interpreted (C).

If applicable effluent or in-stream limits are derived from or evaluated against instream waste concentration, different readings of the formula or its inputs change the computed limit or comparison value.

candidates.exact_span: F = Fraction of stream allow ed for mixing (see "Procedures for Implementing NPDES Permits in New Mexico")
candidates.computation_change_reason: The mixing fraction F is a direct input to instream concentration calculations; a different assigned or interpreted value of F changes the resulting concentration and thus which numeric limit applies or whether a measurement exceeds it.

candidates.exact_span: Qa = Critical low flow of stream at discharge point expressed as the 4Q3 or harmonic mean flow for human health criteria
candidates.computation_change_reason: Ambiguity over whether 4Q3 or harmonic mean flow applies in a given case changes Qa in the instream calculation and therefore the computed limit or comparison concentration.

candidates.exact_span: The follow ing formular convert metals reported in total form to dissolved form if criteria are in dissolved form
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether and when total metal results must be converted to dissolved form determines which numeric dissolved criteria are enforceable for comparison against reported measurements.

The dissolved fraction calculation governs conversion from total-metal criteria to applicable dissolved limits; different interpretation of inputs or applicability of the equation changes the enforceable numeric limit.

candidates.exact_span: TSS = Total suspended solids concentration found in receiving stream (or in effluent for intermittent stream)
candidates.computation_change_reason: The source of TSS (receiving stream versus effluent, including the intermittent-stream condition) affects Kp and dissolved-fraction calculations and therefore the applicable dissolved metal limit.
This equation defines how dissolved criteria are back-calculated to total-metal enforceable limits; its interpretation directly sets the numeric limit used for compliance comparison.

candidates.exact_span: The follow ing formular is used to calculate hardness dependent criteria
candidates.computation_change_reason: Hardness-dependent criteria formulas determine the enforceable numeric limits for metals whose standards vary with hardness; different applicability or parameter readings change the computed limit.

candidates.exact_span: If Stream pH < 6.5, enter 750 in cell O113
candidates.computation_change_reason: The conditional substitution of a fixed acute aluminum limit when stream pH is below 6.5 changes which numeric limit applies (A) and may bear on whether stream pH evidence is required to establish applicable monitoring or limit conditions (B).

candidates.exact_span: If Stream pH < 6.5, enter 87 in cell P113
candidates.computation_change_reason: The conditional substitution of a fixed chronic aluminum limit when stream pH is below 6.5 changes the applicable numeric limit (A) and may affect whether pH-dependent conditions must be established before evaluating monitoring or limit applicability (B).
The cadmium acute hardness-correction factor is an input to the acute criterion formula; different hardness values or formula application change the resulting enforceable limit.
